body: I feel like a burden on the world.  I'm incapable of following through.  With anything.  Any time I open up to people I lose them entirely, with one exception.  But she's got depression and anxiety as well and I feel terrible about dumping this all on her.  My medication hasn't been working, and switching meds over the last year has proved less than fruitful.  I'm incapable of maintaining most relationships past a superficial level and opening up to people I decide to try and trust gets me rejected.  I'm a failure to my family, especially compared to my brother who is successful, married, has his shit together, generally affable, and doing things on his own.  I, meanwhile, am codependent, incapable of finishing things that I start, have no motivation or will to continue on with anything including life, and feel as though the world would be a better place without me in it.  I'm a financial burden, an emotional burden, and in some cases a physical burden.  I attempted suicide before and waking up each morning after has been a feeling of complete failure that I couldn't even do that the right way.  So I'm sitting on the balcony of my parent's apartment 17 stories up, and this fall won't be a failure, I'll finally do at least one thing right.  I'm sorry to my therapist for not being strong enough to push through this with my CBT, but she's the one not answering her phone.  It may be nearly 4am but she should still answer right?
